audit.summary: An exact additive-head counterexample refutes the inference from delayed influential-order switching to computational interactions, affecting the central pathway contribution. Published translation example scores corroborate an undisclosed character/space BLEU convention; one illustrated ranking reverses under word tokenization. Those scoring-evidence consequences are Major; corrected aggregate Table8 results remain unknown. PPL labeling, random-Jaccard expectation and duplicated transfer table are Minor.
limitations: No author code, model, dataset experiment or empirical replication executed.
Separate OpenReview supplement inaccessible (403); full embedded appendices inspected.
External trained masks, 47 preparation-excluded payload paths and original generations were not acquired.
Existing NLTK3.9.1 used for independent scoring; jieba unavailable and not installed or run. Constructed triple-space strings reproduce five of six printed scores; sixth mismatch retained.
Table8 cell has no execution count or retained outputs; historical oracle paragraph-selection effect and corrected aggregate ranking unresolved.
No exhaustive later-revision/erratum or novelty determination.
No conversation URL, independently observed UI model label, native-agent model ID or accessible Space reference exposed.
The original report's complete scope, counterevidence and unresolved questions are retained below.
